missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Полиция' is the feminine nominative subject of 'приехала', which agrees in feminine gender. 'На место' marks destination. A practical emergency sentence.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Полиция' stays nominative as the subject. 'Местная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'очень быстро' describes the action. A simple descriptive statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Полицию' is the accusative direct object of 'вызвали'. The feminine accusative ending replaces -я with -ю, and 'ночью' adds time. A crucial survival phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive after verb. 'Полиции' is the genitive form required by 'бояться'. 'С детства' adds duration, a natural way to express a long-held fear.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В полицию' uses the accusative after 'в' to mean calling to the police as an institution. 'Утром' marks time, a common practical pattern.

missions.phrase: Свидетель обратился к полиции за помощью.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative case. 'К полиции' uses the dative after 'к' to express turning to the police. 'За помощью' states the purpose. A formal, useful construction.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of agent. 'Полицией' is the instrumental form naming who performed the arrest in a passive sentence. 'Задержан' is the short participle. A typical news-style structure.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В полиции' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to mean inside the police station. 'Документы' is the accusative object, a realistic bureaucratic scene.

missions.phrase: О полиции часто пишут в газетах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О полиции' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'В газетах' is a prepositional plural, a tidy double-prepositional example.
Strategic focus: Nominative coordination. 'Полиция' is nominative, joined by 'и' to 'врачи' as a compound subject. The verb 'прибыли' agrees in the plural. A clear coordination example.
